# Purpose

`FLRebuild` collects the functions used to condition operating models, score
rebuilding, and pass the same biological assumptions to JABBA, SPiCT and FLICC.
This note is the map. Each later vignette is one workflow.

```{r setup, eval=FALSE}
library(FLRebuild)
```

# What to use when

| Question | Function | Vignette |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Priors shared by JABBA, SPiCT and FLICC | `canonicalPriors()`, `jabbaPriors()` | Unified prior thread |
| Fit a JABBA run from an `FLStock` | `jabbaInput()`, `runJABBA()` | JABBA workflow |
| Where process error sits in the biomass update | `pe()` | Production misspecification |
| Equilibrium curve from a Stock Synthesis run | `curveSS()` | SS equilibrium plot |
| Kobe probabilities without a new Monte Carlo | see the MVLN vignette | SS3 MVLN Kobe probabilities |
| Yield-per-recruit inputs for FLICC | `asFliccPriorsYpr()` | FLICC on the YPR track |
| Years to a biomass target | `rebuild()`, `rebuildTime()` | — |

`rebuild()` projects an `FLBRP` to a target SSB under a chosen fishing
mortality. `rebuildTime()` reports how long that recovery takes. Both need a
conditioned `FLBRP`; they are not the Kobe-probability clock in
`kobeRebuildTime()`.

# A minimal rebuilding call

```{r rebuild-call, eval=FALSE}
library(FLCore)
library(FLBRP)
library(FLRebuild)

data(ple4)
eq <- FLBRP(ple4)
# Forward projection from a fraction of BMSY SSB, with F set to zero
stk <- rebuild(eq, targetF = 0, initial = 20)
rebuildTime(stk)
```

`initial` is the number of starting biomasses between `minVal` and `maxVal`,
not a year. The returned stock is renamed so year 1 is the first projected
year.
